skills.name: 醉锋
skills.text: 出牌阶段限X次（X为你的体力上限），你可弃置一个花色的唯一手牌并选择一名角色，你观看其的手牌并展示其中一张。若弃置牌与展示牌花色相同，你对其造成1点火焰伤害。其可将此牌当【酒】对你使用。

skills.name: 顾曲
skills.text: 锁定技，你的回合内：被展示过的手牌称为“阙”；手牌中有“阙”的其他角色只能使用“阙”；“阙”只能因“醉锋”转化；当有“阙”被使用后，你摸两张牌。

currentVersusFormal: The hero page and formal release omit the current selected OL client Guqu clause that Qu can only be converted by Zuifeng. This implementation follows the unique spells 4025/4024 bound to character gid770 in the freshly fetched public client. Client DATA_GUQV availability excludes the source, requires the living source, and restricts true Use rather than pure Played. No dated rule-change announcement is inferred.
engineeringInterpretations: Zuifeng pays exactly one legal real Hand discard of a standard effective suit occurring once in the current Hand. Its per-Play quota uses the real phase and current MaxHP, without a once-per-suit lock or reset on regrant.

The selected living holder may be the source. Full viewing is private to the activator; exactly one real Hand entity is publicly revealed. Same-suit fire damage resolves through native children before the optional original-entity Alcohol use.

The special Alcohol permission allows its holder to truly use the exact still-owned revealed Hand entity on the original Zhou Yu outside their own Play or ordinary quota. Native payment, card restrictions, ordinary Alcohol debit, nonstacking effect and typed returns still apply.

Guqu lasts until that actual TurnEnded. It captures genuine public Hand reveal events, including other reveal skills, and excludes private peeks, ordinary use exposure, gifts and mere face-up movement.

While another actor holds Qu for a living source, every material in a true Use must be that source current-turn Qu; zero-material Use is forbidden. Conversion of such Qu is permitted only by the exact Zuifeng Alcohol permission. The source is excluded from these actor restrictions.

Each actual true Use containing Qu yields one native draw-two for each entitled source, rather than once per material. Pure Played is unrestricted and does not yield this benefit. Accepted use rights are frozen before subsequent hand changes.

Qu capture and pending draw claims retain the complete skill source instance and gameplay hash. An independent later copy does not inherit another instance merely because its owner seat matches; already accepted claims retain their original native parent and materials.

The project treats independently acquired skill instances as independent sources: copies already present at a genuine reveal each sign their own mark and each receive draw-two for a qualifying later Use. This is a project runtime interpretation, not an asserted official duplicate-skill FAQ.

Holding Qu in Hand activates the restriction, but it does not add a new material-zone limit: the same marked entity may be used from a natively legal owned region such as Wooden Ox grain. Every actual material must still be Qu, and all original ownership, payment and conversion checks remain in force.

The baseline faction-defense supplier Dodge is a response-only Played action and earns no Guqu draw. No additional lord Use is invented. A faction Slash request that already creates a complete native lord CardUse is handled through that actual Use.

A native actor replacement on the same accepted Use retains the original qualification only through its exact original UseID, ActionID, provider, physical materials and ordered actor-replacement events. It does not acquire a new mark or sample a replacement source.
